titlePlain: Planning the SQL Query Before Opening
subtitle: Video 5 of 22 · Northfield Retail

code:
Grain:     exactly one row per CustomerID
           (never one row per order — fan-out joins
            silently inflate every count)

Reference: a single @AsOfDate variable
           (never GETDATE() buried in the logic)
caption: Get these two wrong, and nothing downstream is trustworthy.

code:
last_order_date = most recent OrderDate, OrderTotal > 0
days_since_last = days(last_order_date, @AsOfDate)
purchases_12mo  = orders in the trailing 12 months

if days_since_last <= 90:          Active
elif days_since_last > 90
     and purchases_12mo >= 2:      Churned
else:                              Not Yet Retained
caption: A direct restatement of the lesson 1 and lesson 3 rulings.
